title: PRD-07 Spring launch run
summary: Production cost centre for the Medlock 2 Spring launch run at Manchester, managed by Daniel Okafor.
body:
Cost centre PRD-07 (Spring launch run) is an active production cost centre in manufacturing unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor (DOKAFOR)]][^r1]. It covers the Medlock 2 spring launch run building at Manchester, which starts assembly in January 2027 and targets approximately 600 battery packs a day once at rate[^r11][^r12][^r13]. The cost centre was opened effective 1 October 2026 to capture maintenance call-outs, non-capitalised workshop consumables, and advance material purchase commitments ahead of pre-series validation[^r10][^r14].

## Purpose and operational scope

Cost centre PRD-07 was established effective 1 October 2026 for the Medlock 2 launch run, with assembly scheduled to commence in January 2027[^r10][^r13][^r14]. It captures maintenance call-outs and non-capitalised workshop consumables required ahead of pre-series validation[^r10]. In full production, the launch run aims to build roughly 600 battery packs per day[^r11]. 

In purchasing and requisition workflows, PRD-07 serves as the default cost centre for Purchase manager [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor]][^r7]. All launch orders and requisitions for launch run battery packs must be charged against PRD-07 to commit assembly materials to the Manchester shop floor[^r12][^r14].

## Budgets and spend history

In the current period (2026-Q4), as of 26 October 2026 09:00, PRD-07 has an authorised budget of £1,500,000, committed expenditure of £310,000, and available headroom of £1,190,000[^r2][^r3].

Historical quarterly budgets and commitments recorded across previous periods include:
* 2025-Q1: budget 558,000 (committed 483,393.59)[^r4]
* 2025-Q2: budget 524,000 (committed 300,237.65)[^r4]
* 2025-Q3: budget 633,000 (committed 435,462.74)[^r4]
* 2025-Q4: budget 675,000 (committed 533,069.32)[^r4]
* 2026-Q1: budget 707,000 (committed 438,821.35)[^r5]
* 2026-Q2: budget 533,000 (committed 482,673.25)[^r5]
* 2026-Q3: budget 561,000 (committed 318,515.18)[^r5]

## Purchase order commitments

In October 2026, major purchase orders were booked against PRD-07 for launch preparations[^r8]. These include PO/2026/01167 with a basic value of 860,000.00 (£1,032,000.00 for [[items-box|BOX-BIKE-01]]), PO/2026/01178 with a basic value of 1,944,880.00 (£2,333,856.00 for [[items-frm|FRM-DEA-S-RED]]), and PO/2026/01179 with a basic value of 384,000.00[^r8][^r9].

## Versions and conflicts

* **Future period allocation (2027-Q1)**: Today's active budget period is 2026-Q4, with £1,500,000 allocated and £310,000 committed[^r2]. From 1 January 2027, period 2027-Q1 allocates a budget of 521,000 with 0 committed (`future_dated`)[^r6].
